user.title: Set up condensate frost monitor
user.description: Select the temperature sensors. Pipe and outdoor sensors are required.

data_description.pipe_sensor: Temperature probe inside the condensate pipe.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor air temperature, used for frost degree, cold sum and coupling.
data_description.soil_sensor: Undisturbed soil next to the drain. Soil entities are only created when set.

weather.title: Weather station (optional)
weather.description: All optional. Extra entities are only created for sensors you set.

data_description.humidity_sensor: For dew point and defrost weather. Sufficient on its own; dew point is then calculated.
data_description.rain_sensor: An increasing precipitation counter, e.g. total_rain or daily_rain. Resets are handled.
data_description.forecast_entity: A weather entity with forecasts, e.g. DWD, AstroWeather or Met.no. Hourly forecasts are preferred.

heatpump.title: Heat pump (optional)
heatpump.description: Heat pump signals, e.g. via EMS-ESP. All optional; entities are only created for inputs you set.

data_description.defrost_entity: A binary sensor that is on while defrosting, or a text sensor such as compressor activity (EMS-ESP: hpactivity) reporting “defrost”.
data_description.pan_temp_sensor: Drain pan temperature of the outdoor unit (EMS-ESP: hpta4).
data_description.heat_cable_entity: Heating cable in the condensate drain (EMS-ESP: heatcable).

error.same_sensor: Each sensor may only be used once.

abort.already_configured: This pipe sensor is already monitored.

init.title: Sensors
init.description: Change sensors or add/remove the soil sensor.

data_description.pipe_sensor: Temperature probe inside the condensate pipe.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor air temperature, used for frost degree, cold sum and coupling.
data_description.soil_sensor: Undisturbed soil next to the drain. Soil entities are only created when set.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Starting values; tune them after first pour tests and defrost cycles. Sections for sensors you have not set up are hidden.

analysis.name: Pipe sensor analysis
analysis.description: How the pipe temperature is smoothed and evaluated. Basis for all states below.

data_description.baseline_hours: Window for the pipe's normal value (median). Longer is calmer but adapts more slowly to seasons.
data_description.slope_minutes: Window for the slope (linear fit). Longer smooths the sensor's 0.1 K steps better but reacts more slowly.
data_description.span_minutes: Window for the span (max − min). Shows how much the pipe temperature moved recently.
data_description.event_threshold: Above this deviation a sample counts as an event (defrost water, backlog). The normal value is then frozen.

plateau.name: Freezing plateau (warning)
plateau.description: Freezing water holds the temperature at exactly 0 °C for a long time. If the pipe sensor sticks there, water is standing and freezing.

data_description.plateau_band: How close to 0 °C the pipe must be. Some margin is needed because wireless sensors are off by a few tenths.
data_description.plateau_slope: Maximum rate of change. A real plateau is almost flat.
data_description.plateau_minutes: Both conditions must hold this long without interruption. Avoids false alarms from briefly passing cold water.

below_zero.name: Pipe below zero (alarm)
below_zero.description: Water in the pipe is frozen solid or the pipe is empty and cold.

data_description.below_zero_threshold: Alarm threshold. Slightly below 0 °C so measurement error at freezing point does not trigger it.
data_description.below_zero_minutes: How long the pipe must stay below.

stagnant.name: Suspected backlog (warning)
stagnant.description: Pipe temperature clearly differs from normal but barely moves. Flowing water drains away; standing water keeps its temperature.

data_description.stagnant_deviation: Minimum deviation from normal for a backlog to be considered.
data_description.stagnant_span: Maximum movement within the span window. Below this the temperature counts as stuck.
data_description.stagnant_minutes: How long the state must last.

soil.name: Soil (info)
soil.description: Early warning when frost approaches the pipe from above.

data_description.soil_frost_threshold: Soil temperature at which the frost front counts as close. The reference sensor sits above the pipe.
data_description.soil_frost_minutes: How long the soil sensor must stay below.

weather.name: Weather station
weather.description: Evaluation of the optional weather station sensors.

data.defrost_spread: Defrost weather: max dew point spread
data.wind_chill_speed: Wind chill from hourly mean wind

data_description.defrost_temp_min: Lower outdoor temperature for defrost weather. Below this the air is usually too dry for much frost.
data_description.defrost_temp_max: Upper outdoor temperature for defrost weather. Above this the evaporator usually defrosts on its own.
data_description.defrost_spread: Maximum gap between temperature and dew point. Small means humid air, so the evaporator frosts quickly.
data_description.wet_pit_rain_7d: Above this 7-day rainfall the soakaway counts as wet and absorbs condensate poorly.
data_description.wind_chill_speed: Above this hourly mean wind, frost plus wind cools the vertical pipe further. Set higher if the station is more exposed than the heat pump.

forecast.name: Forecast (info)
forecast.description: Early warnings from the weather forecast.

data_description.forecast_frost_threshold: If the forecast minimum for the next 24 h is at or below this, you get an early warning.
data_description.clear_sky_cloud: Maximum cloud cover for a frost night to count as clear. On clear nights the ground cools more than the air by radiation.
data_description.calm_wind: Maximum wind for radiative frost. Wind mixes the air and prevents strong cooling at ground level. 3 m/s is about 11 km/h.
data_description.radiative_temp: On clear, calm nights the ground gets 2–4 K colder than the air at 2 m. Ground frost is therefore likely even when the air forecast is still just above 0 °C.
data_description.clear_night_offset: How much colder your site gets than forecast in clear, calm hours (negative). Applied to forecast lows, frost hours and "Frost forecast". To determine it, compare the measured low of a clear frost night with the forecast.

heatpump.name: Heat pump
heatpump.description: Evaluation of defrost cycles and the drain pan.

data_description.defrost_reaction_threshold: How far the pipe temperature must move away from the baseline after a defrost for the water to count as arrived.
data_description.defrost_reaction_minutes: How long after the defrost ends to wait for a response before counting it as missed.
data_description.defrost_miss_count: Consecutive defrosts without response that trigger the warning. Small defrosts sometimes do not reach the probe.
data_description.pan_frost_threshold: Below this pan temperature condensate in the outdoor unit may freeze.
data_description.pan_frost_minutes: How long the pan must stay below.

fault.name: Sensor fault
fault.description: Detection of failed or empty wireless sensors.

data_description.stale_minutes: If the pipe or soil sensor sends no new value for this long, it counts as faulty (e.g. flat battery, lost radio).

maintenance.name: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: While maintenance mode is on, no notifications are triggered and the status shows “Maintenance”.

data_description.maintenance_hours: Maintenance mode then switches itself off so it is not forgotten. 0 = never.
